key_insight: SciForge is an AI-native scientific workbench that keeps human judgment in the interface while modular agents handle multimodal parsing, reasoning, execution, and auditable research-state management.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical blueprint for building research assistants that preserve provenance, coordinate workflows, and support end-to-end scientific discovery across papers, code, data, models, and figures.
method: Goal-scoped governance with review gates and shared decision surfaces
Translate-then-reason pipeline using domain-specific scientific object translators
Evidence-DAG sidecar for provenance chains, audit findings, and traceability
evidence_signal: The abstract reports eight end-to-end user cases, including multi-day agentic research sprints for gene discovery, protein design, molecular optimization, and genome-to-BGC discovery.
watch_item: The system’s collaborative team-science features are still limited, since shared team workspaces are planned for future releases rather than fully delivered now.
paper_title: SciForge: An AI-Native, Multimodal Workbench for Scientific Discovery
